# Huly modules that deliberately get no tools. One module per line; "prefix*" matches several.
# The weekly module check (.github/scripts/huly-modules.ts) reports every other module without tools.

server-*            # server-side model (triggers, presenters) — no user data
presentation        # UI framework classes
workbench           # UI navigation, applications, widgets
text-editor         # editor extensions
uploader            # UI upload handlers
converter           # internal formatters
desktop-preferences # desktop app settings
preference          # per-user UI preferences (out of scope since 3.0.0)
analytics           # product analytics (out of scope since 3.0.0)
billing             # Huly Cloud billing tiers
gmail               # mail integration (out of scope since 3.0.0)
telegram            # Telegram integration (out of scope since 3.0.0)
bitrix              # Bitrix integration (out of scope since 3.0.0)
board               # hidden in current Huly versions
